listing:
UW Winter 2027 Co-op Sublet — Super Close to Plaza & MC!

Hey everyone! Looking for someone to take over my furnished bedroom from Jan 1 to Apr 30, 2027 while I'm away on co-op. It's in a modern student apartment about a 6-minute walk to MC and right by the University Plaza and ION stop. Rent is $910/month and includes heat, water, hydro, and high-speed Wi-Fi. You'll share the unit with 3 quiet UW students; the landlord lives out of town, not in the building. Message me at uwplaza.sublet27@example.com and I'd be glad to meet up and show you the place in person!
label_rationale: Legitimate-sounding listing with fair rent ($910/mo), off-site landlord, and in-person viewing offered, but NO street address or verifiable intersection is provided ('right by the University Plaza'). Under SPEC D4 (ungeocodable/missing address = unknown, escalates—never guess) and D6 verdict policy (missing address requires human confirmation), verdict is HOLD.
